subject: Re: Kickoff: Dream Fields 3D asset demo
body:
Decisions ahead of the July 2 LRB submission:

1. Demo scope locks at 60 curated prompts across the categories the creative-tools folks care about. Thin-structure prompts stay in — Tereza's annealing schedule made them presentable and they show honesty about limits.
2. Per-asset cost goes in the readout exactly as Tereza framed it: ~35 GPU-minutes per object today, distillation/amortization as the Q3 roadmap. I'd rather set that expectation now than get it as an LRB question.
3. Mesh cleanup stays manual for the demo; Chiara documents the workflow rather than automating it this half.
4. Data plan unchanged: expanded prompt corpus ingestion stays parked for late July per Deshawn's schedule with the Corpus team — nothing about the migration timeline affects the demo.

Submission goes in Monday. Really pleased with where this landed.

Lucia
